summary: The feature is implemented in rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. Nothing is committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run because the instructions barred running repository code, so everything was checked by reading only. Please run the test suite and mypy before merging. Choices made: Progress.open is not overloaded (module-level open passes a str mode, which would fail against literal overloads), so its return type is Union[TextIO, BinaryIO]. Columns are description, bar, DownloadColumn, and time remaining, with no percentage column. Suppressions were added only where the spec names them and may be unused under strict mypy. Unverified risk: on Python 3.6, typing.BinaryIO may make _ProgressReader abstract (mode/name), so instantiation could fail there even though the module imports.
